contract: ../PICHHOLA_IMPLEMENTATION.md: supplied Pichhola Hours board, eleven screens, exact two fonts, time-aware home and truthful content labels.

accessibility.evidence: Playwright checked keyboard skip-link focus, labelled controls, pressed/selected states, 44px navigation targets and reduced-motion animations; rendered bilingual text and focus reviewed. Focused checks only, not a full WCAG audit.

responsive.evidence: Browser assertions verify document width never exceeds all three required mobile viewports; screenshot review covers those sizes plus 1440x900.

loading.evidence: Camera upload test holds the API request open and confirms processing status and selected-photo preview.

empty.evidence: Unmatched place search shows Nothing matched your search and the All reset restores places; empty saved collection offers Explore places.

error.evidence: Camera API 503 displays a retryable error and keeps the capture control usable; prior suite verifies dark photos, timeouts and offline enquiries.

partial.evidence: Sample story, artisan and visit information stay visibly labelled; arbitrary ratings and confidence percentages are absent.

success.evidence: Place and story bookmarks survive reload, appear in Profile and can be removed; thumbnails update the hero.

permission.evidence: Camera denial test confirms upload remains available and place links offer a recovery path; fake live-camera capture also passed.

renderedEvidence.observation: All eleven reference screens, saved collection and neutral home captured; reference composition reviewed. Recognition starts at top after selection.
Morning search, category controls, feature card and navigation fit; all reference screens captured without horizontal overflow.
Narrow layouts retain readable bilingual titles, photo selection, navigation and vertical scrolling. All reference states captured.
Centered application shell and navigation align; keyboard skip link is visible when focused.

validation.finalTargetedBrowserSuite: 29 passed against the final production build
validation.deviceLimit: Physical iOS/Android, real camera/torch and voice availability not tested.
